thread:
nora-cs: Heads-up on Helionix (dedicated). Their p95 for /v1/respond rose ~20% last 3 days during end-of-day batches. UX sluggish but errors unchanged. Renewal in 6 weeks so want proactive ask.

oscar-ops: Any customer-side changes?

nora-cs: They increased batch uploads and some clients switched to longer context summaries (median ~640 tokens). Also a +15% weekly traffic bump.

jules-ml: Sounds like a classic KV churn + decode window problem. Quick idea: route super-short queries (<=256 tokens) to a small compact-int8 model, medium (257-512) to compact-fp16, long >512 stay on base-fp16. Should recover p95 without broad model swap.

viv-se: Checklist before canary: 1) top-20 intent regression eval, 2) PII leak scan on outputs, 3) rollback trigger (auto if p95 > baseline * 1.12). Also confirm SLA for their reserved pool.

nora-cs: Proposed tiny routing rule and canary params below. I'll get PM sign-off if everyone agrees.

routing_proposal_snippet:
- predicate: tokens <= 256 -> model: micro-compact-v1@int8
- predicate: 257 <= tokens <= 512 -> model: compact-v1@fp16
- else -> model: base-v2@fp16

canary_plan:
- fraction: 0.12 of eligible traffic for 24h
- metrics: p50/p95 latency, top_intent_f1, token_cost_delta
- rollback_if: p95 > baseline*1.12 or top_intent_f1_drop > 0.03

ops-bot: Canary request queued: #canary-7204 scheduled in 20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oscar-ops: I'll prewarm KV and enable a transient prefix cache TTL=3m for frequent invoice headers. Will set autoscale headroom and a QPS throttle at 3.8k.

jules-ml: I'll wire the eval harness to compare micro-compact-v1 vs base-v2 on semantic similarity and hallucination rates. If regressions <2% and latency improves ~28%, recommend widening route for tokens<=256.

nora-cs: I'll message Helionix PM with the plan and note this as a proactive perf offer in renewal tracker (positive signal). Planning to run canary after PM thumbs.

viv-se: Once PM approves, I'll run compliance sign-off and add the note to the account playbook.

nora-cs: Sample canary API we can run once PM approves:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/accounts/helionix/canary" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -d '{"predicate":"tokens <= 256","fraction":0.12,"model":"micro-compact-v1","quant":"int8","rollback_if":"p95>baseline*1.12 or top_intent_f1_drop>0.03"}'
```

ops-bot: Canary created: #canary-7204 -> micro-compact-v1 (dedicated) scheduled.

oscar-ops: Will post canary metrics in this thread.

nora-cs: Thanks all. Follow-ups: PM approval, run canary, evals + infra checks, then decision. /end
